specialty.quote: Free-text medical transcripts (doctor-patient conversations or dictated notes).

serving.text_only_input_quote: transcript = "Patient is a 45-year-old male presenting with..."
serving.system_prompt: Convert the following medical transcript to a structured medical note. Use these sections in this order: Demographics, Presenting Illness, History of Presenting Illness, Past Medical History, Surgical History, Family History, Social History, Allergy History, Medication History, Dietary History, Review of Systems, Physical Exam Findings, Labs and Imaging, ASSESSMENT, PLAN. Please use only the information present in the transcript. If an information is not mentioned or not applicable, state "Not applicable."
serving.notes: The card's example uses max_new_tokens 2048, temperature 0.2, top_p 0.85, min_p 0.1, top_k 20, and do_sample true. The repository has model.safetensors and no adapter_config.json. The card says Unsloth was used for fine-tuning and merging, so the LoRA is treated as merged. Rank and alpha are not stated. config.json max_position_embeddings is 131072. The dataset card states train num_examples 1930 and does not say whether the text is human or synthetic. Rows shown on the dataset page are endocrinology visits. The model card does not name a specialty. arXiv HTML at https://arxiv.org/html/2507.03033 returned 404. The paper's data-availability lines name OnDeviceMedNotes/Medical_Summary_Notes and starfishdata/endocrinology_structured_notes_1500, not this repository or this dataset id. The paper says that related model was fine-tuned with PEFT LoRA on 1,500 synthetic pairs. Those sentences are not used as facts about this checkpoint. The repo also contains OnDevice LLM.pdf, which was not downloaded. The space Johnyquest7/medical-transcription-notes is linked from the paper, not from this card.

evaluation_reported.text: The card lists metrics bertscore, bleurt, and rouge and reports no scores. The linked paper reports ROUGE-1 0.496 and BERTScore F1 0.866 on a modified ACI benchmark for the model it calls OnDevice, and it does not print this repository id.

discrepancies: The card's method, dataset id, and parent match the inventory. The loss is not named. The dataset split has 1,930 examples, not 1,500. The paper linked from the card does not print this repository id. It names OnDeviceMedNotes/Medical_Summary_Notes and starfishdata/endocrinology_structured_notes_1500.
